subject: Private Offer pricing banding & $/1M token target — follow-up
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@brightwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-05T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Private Offer pricing banding & $/1M token target — follow-up

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick follow-up to capture the pricing guardrails we discussed so the marketplace private offer team can map to a unit price. Can you confirm the ranges below (ballpark is fine for now):

- Expected monthly token consumption (1M-token increments): low: 1M–5M, mid: 6M–25M, high: 26M+
- Target blended unit economics in $/1M tokens (what you need to land in procurement and on the marketplace listing):
  - Preferred target: $___ per 1M tokens
  - Absolute ceiling: $___ per 1M tokens
- Procurement constraints: whether BrightWave must sign via AWS Marketplace private offer, or they can purchase off-invoice directly (helps determine fee stacking)

If you can reply with numbers (even ranges) by EOD Tuesday we’ll run a quick mapping into our marketplace pricing matrix and share a recommended banding and the private-offer draft. I attached the template and a quick unit-econ workbook for reference.

Next steps from our side: I’ll loop Legal/Marketplace and share a draft private offer for your review; Marissa will run the estimate model and propose two price bands (conservative / growth).

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: brightwave_priv_offer_template.pdf (template), estimated_units_model.xlsx (calculator)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@brightwave.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-06T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer pricing banding & $/1M token target — follow-up

Ben —

Appreciate the follow-up and the materials. We had a quick procurement sync this morning and here are the ranges we should use for mapping: 

- Monthly token consumption (est.): low 3M, expected 12M, peak 40M (seasonal spikes up to ~50M)
- Target $/1M tokens: preferred $85 per 1M tokens, ceiling $120 per 1M tokens
- Purchase path: Must be available as an AWS Marketplace private offer (this is a firm requirement for accounting). They may consider direct invoice later but initial purchase must be via Marketplace.

Notes: the preferred $85 target is what our finance says keeps the unit economics neutral for Q1 trials. If you can provide a two-band option (pilot / committed) with clear breakpoints and what the effective monthly commitment thresholds would be, that would help our procurement team.

Also CC'd procurement@brightwave.ai in case they want to add details.

Thanks,
Alicia Gomez
Head of Product Partnerships | BrightWave Analytics
alicia@brightwave.ai

-----Original message-----
On Fri, Dec 5, 2026 at 4:12 PM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (original message quoted)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-06T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Private Offer pricing banding & $/1M token target — internal notes

Ben / Karthik —

Looping you both with Alicia’s reply. Quick internal recommendations before we send the marketplace draft: 

- Proposal: two-tier private offer
  1) Pilot band: 1M–15M tokens/month at $110 per 1M (short-term non-committed trial pricing)
  2) Committed band: 16M+ tokens/month at $78 per 1M (12-month commit, automatic invoice via Marketplace PO)
- Rationale: pricing gap preserves margin while allowing us to show unit-econ improvement as they scale. The $78 committed band meets their preferred $85 target after accounting for marketplace fees and reserved capacity optimizations.
- Internal ask: need approval to present committed band at $78 (will impact revenue recognition cadence; finance flagged for visibility).

I attached the filled estimate model with the scenarios run. If Finance signs off, we can generate the AWS private offer and send DocuSign for approval.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: estimated_units_model.xlsx (scenario tabs: pilot_vs_commit, fee_rollup)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-07T10:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer pricing banding & $/1M token target — internal notes

Thanks for the draft, Marissa. Quick decision: Finance is comfortable with presenting the two-tier structure. A couple of operational items before we go live:

- Confirm whether BrightWave requires net-30 or net-45 on the Marketplace private offer (procurement asked about payment terms). If net-45, we need to model cashflow impact.
- Marketplace listing text: we should surface the committed-breakpoint clearly ("16M tokens/month minimum commitment for committed pricing"). Marissa, can you draft the language for the AWS PO description?
- Legal: I’ll ask Legal to expedite a short addendum for the private offer that clarifies data handling and audit rights (BrightWave is in analytics; they want explicit logging retention terms).

Ben — please reply to Alicia confirming: (1) pilot vs committed band numbers (2) timeline to issue the AWS private offer (we should aim to send the offer within 48 hours if procurement clears).

Karthik
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
thread_summary: Post-demo pricing follow-up for BrightWave: Alicia provided expected token ranges and preferred $/1M target and confirmed requirement for AWS Marketplace private offer. Internal team proposed a two-tier private offer (pilot at $110/1M, committed at $78/1M with 12-month commit and 16M breakpoint). Finance/Legal questions remain about payment terms and data audit clauses. Next step — Ben to confirm bands to BrightWave and produce private offer within 48 hours, pending procurement.
